title: Hoare's partition: two indices walk toward each other
notes: The pivot is the first value. j walks left past bigger values, i walks right past smaller ones, and each time both stop they swap. Then switch to Lomuto's partition and compare: Lomuto makes 13 swaps to Hoare's 7, but only 16 comparisons to Hoare's 37, because Hoare spends three or four comparisons on every range of two values.
